C0.quote: a solution links any ranking of coalitions of players to a binary relation
C0.note: The paper is an axiomatic study of social ranking solutions from cooperative game theory. It maps a ranking over coalitions to a ranking of players by relevance or power. The input is a coalitional ranking, not several agents' submitted inputs aggregated into a collective decision. The 'voters' in CP-majority are only a metaphor for coalitions. The legislature case study ranks parties' power, not a voting outcome. Coding stopped as INELIG.
